info.title: Rwanda Rental Platform API
info.description:
REST API for the Rwanda Rental Platform backend (Cloudflare Workers + Hono). All resources are versioned under `/api/v1`.

**Authentication** is via a server-side session cookie (`rrp_session`, HttpOnly; Secure in production; SameSite=Lax by default). There is **no** Bearer/JWT scheme. Browser clients must send credentials (cookies) on authenticated requests.

**Roles:** `LANDLORD` and `TENANT` only — there is no admin role. Cross-owner access to a resource generally returns **404** (never revealing existence).

**Money** is an integer number of whole Rwandan Francs (RWF); there are no floats and no latitude/longitude fields.

**Providers:** `MTN_MOMO` is implemented; **`AIRTEL_MONEY` is DEFERRED** — it is a declared enum value whose payment initiation currently produces only a plain PENDING intent and whose webhook returns 501 (see `x-provider-status`).

This document is hand-authored from the source code (the authoritative contract) and validated by `npm run docs:validate`.

x-provider-status.MTN_MOMO: IMPLEMENTED (live sandbox verification pending — credentials not configured)
x-provider-status.AIRTEL_MONEY: DEFERRED — declared enum value only; no provider/webhook implementation

cookieAuth.name: rrp_session
cookieAuth.description: Server-side session. Set by register/login as an HttpOnly cookie (Secure in production; SameSite=Lax by default, or None when `SESSION_SAMESITE=None`). Cleared by logout, and revoked on password change/reset. Browser clients must send credentials. The raw token value is never returned in any response body.

message.description: Human-readable, safe message (never contains SQL, stack traces, or secrets).

details.description: Optional structured details (e.g. Zod field errors for 422). Absent unless the endpoint supplies it.

Person.description: Public display identity of another user (never exposes email/phone).

SafeUser.description: Public-facing user shape. NEVER includes passwordHash, session tokens, or reset tokens.

CreatePropertyInput.description: Strict schema — unknown keys (id, landlordId, status, isPublished, currency, ...) are rejected with 422. Money is integer RWF.

UpdatePropertyInput.description: Strict; at least one field required. Same field rules as CreatePropertyInput, all optional.

ManagementProperty.description: Landlord-facing property (own resource). `isPublished` is orthogonal to `status`.

url.description: Relative path to the public image bytes endpoint.

PublicProperty.description: Public listing detail (published properties only). Omits landlordId and isPublished; landlord is display-identity only.

PublicPropertyCard.description: Listing-safe property card for public discovery (B17). Same flat shape as PublicProperty but omits the full description; `images` carries the primary image only. Landlord is display-identity only.

PropertyImage.description: Landlord-facing image metadata. The internal R2 object key is never exposed.

imageIds.description: Must be an exact permutation of the property's current image ids, or 422 INVALID_IMAGE_ORDER.

RentalRequest.description: Tenant view includes `property` (summary); landlord view additionally includes `tenant` (display identity). Tenant/landlord ids are not exposed.

CreateRentalInput.description: Optional dates only; identity/money/status are server-derived. A missing body is treated as {}. Strict — any other key is 422.

endDate.description: Nullable; if both present, startDate must be before endDate.

Rental.description: Tenant view includes `landlord`; landlord view includes `tenant`. Both include `property` (summary).

PaymentProvider.description: MTN_MOMO is implemented. AIRTEL_MONEY is DEFERRED: creation yields a plain PENDING intent (no external call) and its webhook returns 501.

CreatePaymentInput.description: Strict — the only client fields are these four. tenantId/landlordId/propertyId/status/providerTransactionId/currency are server-derived and rejected with 422.

amount.description: Whole RWF; must be > 0 and <= the rental's monthly rent (partial payments allowed; overpayment 422).

Payment.description: Tenant view includes `landlord`; landlord view includes `tenant`. The idempotency key is never returned.

NotificationType.description: RENT_REMINDER is a prepared type only — it is NOT auto-generated (no scheduler exists).

Notification.description: Belongs to exactly one user. Never contains secrets. userId and the dedup event key are not exposed.

UpdateProfileInput.description: Strict; at least one field. role/email/password are NOT editable (422).

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but the role is not permitted.

error.message: You do not have permission to perform this action

NotFound.description: Resource not found (also returned for cross-owner access, to avoid revealing existence).

error.message: Too many requests, please try again later

post.description: Creates a user and immediately issues a session cookie (auto-login). Duplicate email/phone → 409.

409.description: Email or phone already in use.

error.message: An account with this email already exists

401.description: Invalid credentials (generic — does not reveal whether the email exists).

200.description: Password changed; a fresh session replaces the revoked ones.

401.description: Not authenticated, or current password incorrect (AUTH_PASSWORD_INVALID).

post.description: Always returns a generic success and NEVER reveals whether the account exists. Email delivery is deferred; outside production only, a `devResetToken` is included to exercise the flow.

devResetToken.description: Present ONLY outside production; never a production guarantee.

get.description: PUBLIC, unauthenticated discovery of PUBLISHED properties only (`is_published = true` is always enforced server-side, independent of any filter). Supports filtering, a safe text search, pagination, and an allow-listed sort. Usable by visitors, tenants, and landlords. Returns listing-safe cards (landlord name only — never email/phone; primary image only; no storage keys). An empty result is `200` with `properties: []` (never `404`).

post.description: Requires role LANDLORD. Money is integer RWF. The property starts unpublished.

patch.description: Requires a non-empty description, else 400 PROPERTY_INCOMPLETE.

get.description: Published properties only; otherwise 404. Returns listing-safe fields plus landlord display identity and public images.

post.description: multipart/form-data with a single `file`. The backend determines the real type from MAGIC BYTES (JPEG/PNG/WebP; SVG blocked) — the declared MIME/extension is NOT trusted. Max 5 MB, max 20 images/property. The R2 object key is server-generated (no path traversal).

422.description: Order must be an exact permutation (INVALID_IMAGE_ORDER) or invalid body.

get.description: Serves raw image bytes for a PUBLISHED property's image. Response is the image itself (not JSON), with Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600.

post.description: The property must exist, be published, and be AVAILABLE. One active (PENDING/ACCEPTED) request per tenant+property.

value.message: I'd like to rent this from August.

409.description: Property not publishable/available, or a duplicate active request (RENTAL_REQUEST_ALREADY_EXISTS / PROPERTY_NOT_PUBLISHED / PROPERTY_NOT_AVAILABLE).
Not cancellable in the current state (RENTAL_REQUEST_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED).

get.summary: Get a request for an own property (LANDLORD)

patch.description: Sets status to ACCEPTED (not APPROVED). The tenant then converts the ACCEPTED request into a rental (see Rentals).

409.description: Already processed, or property no longer publishable/available (RENTAL_REQUEST_ALREADY_PROCESSED / PROPERTY_NOT_AVAILABLE).

post.summary: Convert an ACCEPTED request into a rental (TENANT)
post.description: The request must be the tenant's own, ACCEPTED, and not already converted; the property must be published and AVAILABLE. Creates an ACTIVE rental and marks the property OCCUPIED (atomic). Body optional (dates only).

409.description: Request not ACCEPTED, already converted, or property not publishable/available (RENTAL_REQUEST_NOT_ACCEPTED / RENTAL_ALREADY_EXISTS / PROPERTY_NOT_AVAILABLE).

get.summary: Get a rental for an own property (LANDLORD)

patch.description: ACTIVE → COMPLETED (property becomes AVAILABLE). A non-ACTIVE rental → 409 RENTAL_NOT_ACTIVE.
ACTIVE → TERMINATED (property becomes AVAILABLE). A non-ACTIVE rental → 409 RENTAL_NOT_ACTIVE.

post.description: Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header (8–255 chars). Creates a PENDING intent for the tenant's own ACTIVE rental. For MTN_MOMO the charge is initiated with the provider; success only ever arrives later via a verified webhook. AIRTEL_MONEY yields a plain PENDING intent (deferred).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same key + same params → idempotent replay (200); same key + different params → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Use an opaque, unguessable value (do not include secrets).

200.description: Idempotent replay of an existing intent (same key + same params).

409.description: Rental not payable, or idempotency key reused with different params (RENTAL_NOT_PAYABLE / IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED).

422.description: Invalid body, or amount exceeds monthly rent (PAYMENT_INVALID_AMOUNT).

get.summary: Get a payment for an own property (LANDLORD)

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: MTN_MOMO is implemented. AIRTEL_MONEY is DEFERRED and returns 501.

post.description: PUBLIC route — NOT user-session authenticated. Each provider adapter authenticates the delivery itself. For MTN_MOMO the callback is authenticated by a shared application-level secret (bearer token or `?token=` in the registered callback URL) — MTN callbacks are NOT cryptographically signed, so this is an application-level defense, not an MTN-native signature. The event is correlated to a payment by (provider, providerTransactionId), re-checked for amount/currency, and applied through the single authoritative state machine; terminal states are never overwritten. The internal provider-event ledger is not a public API. Verified but unmatched/duplicate/conflicting events still return 200 (so the provider stops retrying); only verification/format failures return 4xx.

requestBody.description: Opaque provider payload. For MTN_MOMO the adapter reads externalId (our reference), status, amount, currency, financialTransactionId. Do NOT include real secrets in examples.

200.description: Acknowledged (processed / duplicate / unmatched / conflict / amount-currency mismatch).

400.description: Unsupported provider or malformed event (WEBHOOK_UNSUPPORTED_PROVIDER / WEBHOOK_INVALID_EVENT).

401.description: Provider verification failed (WEBHOOK_VERIFICATION_FAILED). The delivery is NOT persisted.

get.description: Paginated, newest first. Ownership is always the session user; a client-supplied userId is ignored.

200.description: Marked; returns how many were updated.
